newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks close mixed in livelier trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks close mixed in livelier trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks traded mixed in livelier trade on Friday, as fully listed Zagrebacka Banka recovered to 40 kuna off its all time high, and traders expected key issues to rise.

"Zagrebacka will certainly continue growing next week, and so will (drugs firm) Pliva and (food concern) Podravka," Marijan Palic, a trader with Auctor brokerage said, referring to the trio of heavy-weights that dominated Friday trading.
